# Mutual Recognition Agreements

> Source: https://www.cpaireland.ie
> Site: CPA Ireland
> Scraped: 2026-04-16

> Mutual Recognition Agreements

#### •   I became a CPA Ireland member though an MRA. Will I retain my membership?

All CPA Ireland members in good standing, whether through MRA or otherwise, will automatically get the Chartered Accountants Ireland designation.

#### •   Will CPA Ireland members be given new Chartered Accountants Ireland certificates after amalgamation?

#### •   I was approved to CPA membership already, but I have not yet received my certificate. Do I get a CPA certificate now or a Chartered Accountants Ireland certificate and who do I contact?

Please be advised that, due to the recent amalgamation, CPA Ireland certificates will no longer be issued. We recommend that you obtain a membership certificate directly from Chartered Accountants Ireland. Please contact the Member Experience Team on lll@charteredaccountants.ie to order a new certificate.
